item.title: SpaceX Adds 0.5GW of AI Compute Monthly, Targets 1GW by Late 2027
item.description:
Musk said SpaceX is currently adding roughly 0.5GW of AI compute per month, equivalent to deploying about 220,000 GB300 chips plus supporting CPUs, networking and cooling, and plans to exceed 1GW per month by the end of next year. He identified power generation, not chip supply, as the real scaling bottleneck, framing that scale as approaching \\

原文标题：SpaceX 每月新增 0.5GW 算力 明年底提速至 1GW

Why it matters：以芯片等效量级披露超大规模算力扩张节奏，并点明电力成为核心瓶颈，对算力基础设施判断有直接参考价值。

item.title: IMF Warns Overheated AI Investment Could Trigger Market Correction
item.description:
IMF Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva warned that investor enthusiasm for AI is excessive and further market corrections are likely, though such adjustments would help restore sustainability. She flagged roughly $1 trillion in circular AI financing, about two-thirds debt-funded, with the pace and shift toward debt posing financial stability risks. The IMF conservatively estimates AI will add about 0.5 percentage points to global growth, calling 2026 the first year AI materially affects the world economy.

原文标题：IMF 警告 AI 投资过热或引发市场调整

Why it matters：IMF 最高层首次量化 AI 循环融资规模与债务占比，是判断 AI 泡沫风险的关键宏观信号。

item.title: Banks Warn Users Bear Losses From Rogue AI Agent Transactions
item.description:
Major banks including JPMorgan Chase, Citi and Ally Bank are warning customers that actions taken by AI agents with account access may be treated as user-authorized transactions, leaving losses non-reversible. As autonomous shopping agents proliferate, banks and retailers are redrawing liability boundaries through revised terms, access bans and system-level consent prompts.

原文标题：多家银行警告 AI 智能体擅自转账损失自担

Why it matters：银行与零售商集体重划 AI 智能体责任边界，是自主代理落地金融场景的关键合规信号。

item.title: AI Agent Group Breaches 200 Organizations in 11 Days
item.description:
CrowdStrike reports an AI-agent attack group breached more than 200 organizations in 11 days, while Unit 42 finds attack tempo roughly 4x faster than a year ago. The piece lays out a four-pillar response playbook: automated detection and containment, fast communication over secure channels, thorough eradication with outside forensics, and continuous blast-radius reduction, with responsibility shared across suppliers and customers.

原文标题：AI 智能体攻击 11 天入侵 200 家机构

Why it matters：以具体攻击数据揭示 AI 智能体驱动的攻防节奏变化，为企业安全响应提供可操作框架。

item.title: Alibaba H1 Net Profit Rises 17% to 75.07 Billion Yuan
item.description:
Alibaba reported H1 FY2027 revenue of 540.47 billion yuan, up 9% year over year, with net profit attributable to shareholders rising 17% to 75.07 billion yuan, while Non-GAAP net profit fell 7% and free cash flow widened to -79.14 billion yuan. Second-quarter operating profit surged 443%, with heavy AI capital expenditure weighing on profitability, producing a beat on revenue but a miss on profit.

原文标题：阿里 2027 财年上半年净利 750.72 亿元同比增 17%

Why it matters：阿里财报揭示 AI 资本开支对利润端的实质拖累，是观察大厂 AI 投入节奏的关键财务信号。

item.description:

item.title: Musk Says Optimus Humanoid Robot Could Handle Household Chores in 12-18 Months
item.description:
Musk said in a video interview that Optimus should be able to perform multi-step household chores such as taking out trash, washing dishes and putting them away within 12-18 months, following a path from heavy industry to the home. He also teased a new demo in one to two months stressing authenticity, and disclosed early production at Fremont plus a dedicated Giga Texas factory about 65% structurally complete.

原文标题：马斯克称 Optimus 未来 12-18 个月可承担家务

Why it matters：马斯克给出 Optimus 家务能力的时间表与量产进展，是具身智能落地节奏的重要信号。

item.title: Germany Raises Cyber Threat Level to Critical as AI Agents Lower Attack Barrier
item.description:
Germany's BSI raised its IT threat assessment from 'serious' to 'serious to critical', with its cyber security index jumping from 124 to 238 in a year. The report explicitly attributes the shift to high-performance AI models and agentic systems that make vulnerability discovery and exploitation faster, cheaper and more targeted, with attackers now using AI to strike systems directly.

原文标题：德国上调网络威胁至危急 AI 智能体降低攻击门槛

Why it matters：国家级安全机构首次将 AI 智能体列为威胁升级的核心驱动因素，是 AI 安全风险从理论走向监管定性的标志性事件。

item.title: Kai-Fu Lee Calls Agent-Count AI Metrics an Absurd Joke
item.description:
Zero One Infinity CEO Kai-Fu Lee publicly criticized enterprises for measuring AI transformation by process metrics such as agent deployment counts, account numbers and saved work hours, arguing such scorecards obscure real revenue and cost impact. He urged CEOs to instead ask three strategic questions: whether core competitive advantages survive falling intelligence costs, whether AI will amplify or commoditize them, and which business curve to rewrite today if they fail within three years.

原文标题：李开复称企业 AI 转型只看智能体数量是荒谬笑话

Why it matters：李开复对当前企业智能体热潮提出反主流的方法论批评，为 AI 落地评估提供可操作的战略框架。

item.title: Open OCR Costs Fall Fivefold in 18 Months to $130 per Million Pages
item.description:
Hugging Face's Daniel van Strien benchmarked eight open OCR models on identical GPU hardware, finding per-1,000-page cost fell from about 51 cents for April 2025's RolmOCR to under 10 cents for October 2026's LightOnOCR-3-0.8B, a roughly fivefold drop in 18 months. At that rate, digitizing a million pages now costs $65 to $130 in GPU rental, sharply lowering the barrier to large-scale book and archive digitization.

原文标题：开源 OCR 成本 18 个月降 5 倍 百万页仅需 130 美元

Why it matters：用统一硬件与真实古籍样本量化开源 OCR 成本趋势，为文档数字化选型提供直接可用的价格基准。

item.title: PHP 8.6 Ships Partial Function Application and Polling API
item.description:
PHP 8.6 has been released with Partial Function Application, a new \\\\Time\\\\Duration class, a native Polling API built on epoll/kqueue, and a clamp() function. Numerous built-in functions now throw ValueError on out-of-range arguments or return false on stream failures, tightening type safety and I/O scalability.

原文标题：PHP 8.6 发布 引入部分函数应用与轮询 API

Why it matters：PHP 语言年度大版本更新，涉及函数式编程能力与原生异步 I/O 底座，对 Web 后端开发者有直接迁移价值。

item.title: Gartner Forecasts Global AI Spending to Top $4 Trillion by 2027
item.description:
Gartner forecasts global AI spending will reach $4.05 trillion in 2027, up 47.5% year over year, with AI infrastructure accounting for nearly $2.4 trillion, or 59% of the total. AI-optimized servers are the fastest-growing segment at $957.2 billion (+81%), while generative AI model spending rises 82% to $51 billion and domain-specific models nearly double.

原文标题：Gartner 预测 2027 年全球 AI 支出突破 4 万亿美元

Why it matters：Gartner 给出 2027 年 AI 支出全景量化预测，基础设施占比与服务器增速为算力投资判断提供关键锚点。

item.title: South Korean Security Firms Race to Build AI Glasses Cheating Detectors
item.description:
As AI smart glasses become a tool for exam cheating, South Korean security firms K&Us and Gison are developing radio-frequency detectors that analyze Bluetooth and Wi-Fi signals to locate wearers, with K&Us targeting a prototype by early next year. The Korea Radio Promotion Association (KCA) issued a related R&D tender this month, and both firms have joined the bidding.

原文标题：韩国安防企业竞相研发智能眼镜作弊探测仪

Why it matters：反映 AI 硬件普及催生的新型反作弊检测需求，是 AI 落地带来的具体产业动向。

item.title: Compress Memory with zram Instead of Buying More RAM
item.description:
AI-driven parallel workloads are pushing workstation memory demand higher, while RAM remains expensive and often non-upgradable, so the author recommends zram memory compression. zram is enabled by default on Fedora and Pop!_OS but not on Ubuntu; compression ratios commonly reach 1:4 at the cost of some CPU overhead and added latency for certain processes.

原文标题：用 zram 压缩内存替代加购内存条

Why it matters：提供了一条低成本缓解内存瓶颈的实用运维思路，适合本地跑 AI 工作负载的开发者参考。

The report also cites AI progress: in-house models from NetEase Cloud Music and Youdao topped international leaderboards, and NetEase Lingdong embodied-AI robots have been deployed across over 100 engineering projects.

item.title: Lenovo on Track to Hit $100 Billion Revenue as Margins Climb
item.description:
Lenovo Chairman and CEO Yang Yuanqing said the company's $100 billion annual sales target is all but assured, with roughly $57 billion already booked in the first half, and that the focus now shifts to profitability. Second-quarter revenue topped $30 billion for the first time, up 48% year over year, while margins reached 4.5%, approaching the low end of its three-year 5%-8% goal.

item.title: Zerodha Open Sources SQLite-Based Distributed Blob Store
item.description:
Indian brokerage Zerodha built Blobasaur, a sharded, distributed lightweight blob storage server on top of SQLite, to serve high-throughput blob reads and writes for its Kite trading platform. It handles thousands of KB-to-MB JSON blob operations per second on commodity hardware with single-digit millisecond latency. The project is open sourced under AGPLv3, offering smaller teams a lightweight alternative to CouchDB and SSDB.

原文标题：Zerodha 开源基于 SQLite 的分布式 Blob 存储

Why it matters：来自真实生产场景的 SQLite 分布式存储工程实践，附带开源代码，对后端与基础设施读者有直接参考价值。

item.description:
Kuaishou reported 100.843 billion yuan in revenue for the first nine months of fiscal 2026, down 2.3% year over year, while net profit attributable to shareholders fell 62% to 5.088 billion yuan. The third quarter swung to a 961 million yuan net loss, driven by heavier Kling AI investment and contracting core business revenue.

item.description:

With over 30 million paid Copilot users, Microsoft is leaning on cost and ecosystem lock-in as OpenAI and Anthropic push into office software.

item.title: Lenovo CEO Predicts 80% of Compute Will Shift to Edge Devices
item.description:
Lenovo CEO Yang Yuanqing said at the company's quarterly earnings call that in the agent era, devices will become the primary host of AI data and on-device compute, with as much as 80% of compute expected to originate at the device and edge rather than the cloud. He expects AI-native devices such as smart glasses and rings to proliferate, and predicts everyone will eventually need a home server or AI hub.

原文标题：杨元庆预测 80% 算力将来自端侧与边缘侧

item.title: Samsung AI Glasses Sell Out in Hours Ahead of December 10 Launch
item.description:
Samsung's Intelligent Eyewear, an AI glasses collaboration with Google and Gentle Monster, sold out core models within hours of pre-order opening in Korea, the US and other markets. Weighing about 41 grams with built-in camera, speaker and microphone, the glasses run Google's Gemini model for real-time translation, navigation and meeting summaries, priced around 3,257-3,508 RMB, with full retail launch set for December 10 in Korea and the US.

item.title: TrendForce 预测 2027 年 NAND 合约价转入下行
item.description:

item.title: 纳德拉称 AI 代劳网购将重塑互联网商业格局
item.description:
微软 CEO 纳德拉在《纽约时报》DealBook 峰会上表示，能替用户浏览商品并完成购买的 AI 智能体将重塑互联网商业格局，流量分配与平台间付费关系都可能改变。他将这一转变类比为入口从雅虎等门户转向谷歌搜索，并指出亚马逊阻止智能体访问零售站点，若其他平台选择开放则可能获得竞争优势。

item.description:

item.title: 韩国出口额首破 1 万亿美元 AI 芯片需求成主引擎
item.description:
受全球 AI 芯片需求旺盛推动，韩国今年累计出口额突破 1 万亿美元，成为继德国、美国、中国之后第四个达到这一规模的国家，较去年全年 7090 亿美元的纪录大幅跃升。三星电子与 SK 海力士等存储芯片巨头是核心受益方，但韩国国内消费依旧疲软，出口红利尚未传导至家庭端。李在明政府计划设立 162.3 万亿韩元未来应对基金，将芯片超额税收投向 AI、生物等新增长产业。
